description: Grade 5 optional enrichment example: rewrite one bar from 9/8 to 3/4.

provenance.authoredBy: Music Theory Path curriculum team (Brief 10 addendum)

item.prompt: Rewrite this bar of 9/8 in 3/4 so every note and rest keeps the same share of its beat. Beam by the new beats.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 9/8 (three dotted-crotchet beats), unpitched rhythm on a single line.

hints: 9/8 has three dotted-crotchet beats; 3/4 has three crotchet beats. Match each beat to its partner.

feedback.correct: Correct. A dotted minim lasts two dotted-crotchet beats of 9/8, so it becomes a minim (two crotchet beats) in 3/4; the dotted crotchet becomes a crotchet.

mistakes.values-copied-unchanged: Copying the values leaves a bar of the wrong length for 3/4. Compare one beat in each time signature first.
mistakes.rest-not-rewritten: A rest fills the same share of the beat as a note, so it changes in exactly the same way.
mistakes.dots-kept-in-simple-time: A simple beat is undotted, so the dots must come off when going from compound to simple time.
mistakes.beam-across-beats: Start a new beam on each new beat so the beats stay visible.

feedback.fallback: A dotted minim lasts two dotted-crotchet beats of 9/8, so it becomes a minim (two crotchet beats) in 3/4; the dotted crotchet becomes a crotchet.
